title: Account balances and their history
description: In WalletFeed, the screen of an account shows the balance of your Apple Card, Apple Cash or Savings account in a chart, for one week to one year.

title: Ask Spending with Apple Intelligence
description: In Ask Spending, you type text about your Apple Card transactions, for example "Dining this month vs last". WalletFeed shows a chart, a list and a summary.

title: Background Sync
description: Background Sync sends your Apple Card transactions to your destinations while WalletFeed is not open. Automations in Shortcuts can also send them.

title: Filter the transactions for a destination
description: A WalletFeed filter selects the Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions that a destination receives, by account, category, merchant or amount.

title: Destinations
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to an app, a spreadsheet or a file. You can add, change, stop and remove destinations.

title: Make a CSV file with Export CSV
description: Make a CSV file of your Apple Card transactions on your iPhone with Export CSV in WalletFeed. You select a period, then you save or send the file.

title: First steps with WalletFeed
description: Open WalletFeed on your iPhone for the first time and select the Wallet accounts that it can read. Then look at your Apple Card transactions.

title: WalletFeed User Guide
description: How to use WalletFeed on iPhone: Wallet accounts, Spending, Ask Spending, Search, Recurring Charges, destinations, Background Sync and WalletFeed Pro.

title: Privacy and security
description: This page about WalletFeed privacy and security tells you which data WalletFeed keeps and sends, and how to lock the app with Face ID.

title: Recurring Charges and alerts
description: WalletFeed finds the recurring charges on your Apple Card, such as subscriptions. It can send a notification for a new recurring charge or a price change.

title: Search
description: Find your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions with Search in WalletFeed. Type a merchant name or an amount, or use Apple Intelligence.

title: Send previous transactions
description: Send History sends your previous Apple Card transactions to a WalletFeed destination. Initial History sets the start date of new destinations.

title: Siri and Shortcuts
description: Use Siri and the Shortcuts app with WalletFeed on your iPhone to start Ask Spending, find transactions, send Apple Card transactions and get files and balances.

title: Spending widget
description: Put the WalletFeed Spending widget on your iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen. It shows this month, the same point last month and your Apple Card balance.

title: Spending
description: Spending in WalletFeed shows your Apple Card and Apple Cash purchases this month, your account balances and the totals by day, category and merchant.

title: Subscriptions and their cost
description: Subscriptions in WalletFeed shows the charges that repeat on your Apple Card, the date of the next charge and the cost for each month and each year.

title: Get the totals of a year with Tax Pack
description: Tax Pack in WalletFeed gives the totals of your Apple Card transactions for a year, on your iPhone, with files for a tax preparer or an AI assistant.

title: Transactions
description: WalletFeed shows your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions on your iPhone. The list shows pending charges and refunds in month sections.

title: Troubleshooting
description: The steps on this page correct problems with WalletFeed, for example missing cards, "Authentication failed", "Sync Stopped" and copies of transactions.

title: Select the Wallet accounts that WalletFeed reads
description: Give WalletFeed access to your Apple Card, Apple Cash or Savings account on your iPhone. Change the accounts and their start dates in the Settings app.

title: WalletFeed Pro
description: WalletFeed Pro lets WalletFeed send your Apple Card transactions to destinations. This page gives the prices and tells you how to change or cancel a plan.

title: Webhook format
description: The JSON events that a WalletFeed webhook sends, the switch for each event type, and how to examine the Standard Webhooks signature.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to your app or server
description: There is no web API for your Apple Card transactions. iPhone apps read them with FinanceKit. WalletFeed sends them to a webhook, AWS, Supabase or BankSync.

title: Budgeting apps that support Apple Card and Apple Cash
description: The budgeting apps that support Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings on iPhone, from their help pages, and how WalletFeed sends transactions to other apps.

title: Add Apple Card to Copilot Money
description: You can add Apple Card to Copilot Money only in its iPhone app, on iOS 17.4 or newer. The limits, and what to do if Apple Card does not sync with Copilot.

title: Connect Apple Card to Monarch
description: Monarch can connect to Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings in its iPhone app. The steps, the limits, and what to do if Apple Card does not sync in Monarch.

title: Does Plaid support Apple Card? How to connect, and the apps that connect
description: Plaid connects to Apple Card only in iPhone apps that added it, such as Rocket Money. This page gives the steps, the apps, and a procedure for other apps.

title: Link Apple Card to Rocket Money
description: Rocket Money can link to Apple Card in its iPhone app, on iOS 17.4 or newer. The steps to link it, and what to look at if Apple Card does not connect.

title: Apple Pay automation: run a shortcut after each Apple Card purchase
description: Make an Apple Pay automation in Shortcuts. The Transaction trigger starts when you tap your Apple Card, and WalletFeed sends the purchase.

title: See Apple Card spending by category
description: See your Apple Card spending by category: the spending summary in Wallet for a week, a month or a year, and the categories and merchants in WalletFeed.

title: Add an Apple Card spending widget
description: Add an Apple Card spending widget to your iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen. It shows this month, last month to the same day, and your card balance.

title: Get your Apple Card totals and transactions for your taxes
description: Get the year-end totals of your Apple Card and Savings transactions for your taxes: interest, fees, purchases and refunds, and a file of all transactions.

title: Import Apple Card transactions into Actual Budget
description: You can import Apple Card transactions into Actual Budget. WalletFeed writes them to an OFX file each month, and you import the file on a computer.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Airtable
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to an Airtable base. Each transaction is a record.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to AWS
description: Send your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Amazon S3, SQS, Kinesis Data Streams, DynamoDB or EventBridge in your AWS account with WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to BankSync
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to a BankSync table. Your AI agents can read them with BankSync's MCP tools or REST API.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Wallet by BudgetBakers
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions to Wallet by BudgetBakers with no import file. You paste an API token from BudgetBakers in WalletFeed.

title: Connect your Apple Card to ChatGPT with a Google Sheet
description: To connect your Apple Card to ChatGPT, WalletFeed keeps a Google Sheet up to date, and ChatGPT reads it. The page also gives the facts about Finances.

title: How to ask Claude about your Apple Card transactions
description: Ask Claude about your Apple Card transactions. WalletFeed keeps a Google Sheet up to date, and Claude reads it with its Google Drive connector.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Coda
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a table in Coda (Superhuman Docs) with an API token.

title: Save Apple Card transactions to a CSV file automatically
description: WalletFeed writes your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to a CSV file in a folder that you select, and updates the file automatically.

title: Open Apple Card transactions in Excel
description: WalletFeed writes your Apple Card transactions to a CSV file on your iPhone. Excel opens the file on a Mac or a PC.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Firefly III
description: Send Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Firefly III. Make a personal access token in Firefly III. Then paste the token in WalletFeed.

title: How to ask Gemini about your Apple Card transactions
description: Ask Gemini about your Apple Card transactions. WalletFeed keeps a Google Sheet up to date, and Gemini reads it with the Google Workspace app.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to GitHub
description: WalletFeed writes your Apple Card transactions to a private GitHub repository, in a Beancount, hledger or CSV file for each month or each day.

title: Import Apple Card transactions into GnuCash
description: You can import your Apple Card transactions into GnuCash. On your iPhone, WalletFeed writes an OFX file for each month. Then, you import the files.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Google Sheets
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a Google Sheets spreadsheet in your Google Drive.

title: How to ask Grok about your Apple Card transactions
description: Ask Grok about your Apple Card transactions. WalletFeed keeps a Google Sheet up to date, and Grok reads it with its Google Drive connector.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Linear
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Linear, as one issue for each month or one issue for each transaction.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Lunch Money
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to Lunch Money. You paste a Lunch Money access token in WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Make
description: Send your Apple Card transactions to Make (the previous name of Make is Integromat). A Custom webhook receives each month or each change.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Notion
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a Notion database, with Sign In with Notion or a token.

title: Open Apple Card transactions in Numbers
description: Open your Apple Card transactions in a Numbers spreadsheet. WalletFeed saves them from your iPhone to a CSV file in iCloud Drive and updates the file.

title: Save Apple Card transactions as OFX files
description: WalletFeed saves your Apple Card transactions in one OFX file for each month and updates the files automatically. You import the files into your app.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to PocketSmith
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions to PocketSmith with no import file. You make a developer key in PocketSmith and paste it in WalletFeed.

title: Save Apple Card transactions as QIF files
description: WalletFeed saves your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone as QIF files. It writes one QIF file for each month to a folder that you select.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to QuickBooks Online
description: WalletFeed sends your posted Apple Card transactions to a credit card account in QuickBooks Online, with no upload. You connect your company in WalletFeed.

title: Import Apple Card transactions into Quicken for Windows
description: Quicken Classic for Windows has no connection to Apple Card. Import a QFX file from Wallet, or the CSV file that WalletFeed saves for each month.

title: Add Apple Card transactions to Quicken
description: Quicken Classic has no connection to Apple Card. Import a QFX file from Wallet, or use the OFX files that WalletFeed saves for Quicken for Mac.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Supabase
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to a Postgres database in Supabase. Each transaction is one row in a table.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Sure
description: Send Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Sure, a self-hosted fork of Maybe Finance. Add a card account in Sure. Then use Sign In with Sure.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Toshl Finance
description: Send your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to Toshl Finance. Make a personal token in Toshl, then paste it into WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to a webhook
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to a webhook in n8n or on your server.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Xero
description: WalletFeed sends your posted Apple Card transactions to a bank account in Xero, with no statement file. You connect your Xero organization in WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to YNAB
description: WalletFeed sends your Apple Card transactions to YNAB with no import file. You make a personal access token in YNAB and paste it in WalletFeed.

title: Send Apple Card transactions to Zapier
description: Send your Apple Card transactions from your iPhone to Zapier with WalletFeed. A Catch Hook trigger starts your Zap one time a month or for each change.

title: Get an Apple Card year-end summary
description: For an Apple Card year-end summary, Wallet shows your spending for a year. WalletFeed gives the annual totals and one file of the transactions of the year.

title: Ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok about your Apple Card spending
description: Ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok about your Apple Card spending. WalletFeed keeps a Google Sheet up to date, and the chatbot reads it from Google Drive.

title: Download your Apple Card transactions and statements
description: Download your Apple Card transactions as a CSV, OFX, QFX or QBO file, or a PDF statement to print, in Wallet, at card.apple.com or in WalletFeed.

title: Make a CSV export file of your Apple Cash transactions
description: Wallet gives you a PDF file of your Apple Cash transactions in an e-mail. Export CSV in WalletFeed makes a CSV file of them on your iPhone.

title: Make an export file of your Savings transactions
description: Download your Savings statements or an export file of your transactions in Wallet. Export CSV in WalletFeed makes a CSV file of a period that you select.

title: Find and cancel subscriptions on your Apple Card
description: Find each subscription and recurring payment on your Apple Card in WalletFeed, with the cost for one month. Then cancel it on the correct Apple screen.

title: Apple Card budget template for Google Sheets
description: A Google Sheets template with Spending and Budget tabs for your Apple Card transactions. You copy the tabs into the spreadsheet that WalletFeed makes.

title: Guides
description: Step-by-step guides to send Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings transactions from your iPhone to budgeting apps, spreadsheets, files and automations with WalletFeed.

title: Apple Card budget template for Notion
description: A Notion template with a WalletFeed Transactions database and views of your Apple Card spending by month and by category. WalletFeed sends the rows.

title: Search Apple Card transactions
description: Search in WalletFeed finds a purchase in your Apple Card transactions. You can type a merchant, an amount or a category, or use Apple Intelligence.
